description: Keep a figure in this person's cache, with its source id from list_sources, the page URL and the period: one you read in an open source (a city statistics office table), or one the person read on a link-only page (Numbeo) and gave you. Never fetch link-only pages yourself. The figure counts like any other, marked as reported by an agent, unverified; figures from link-only sources are never published by the project.

city.description: City id or name (fetch_city first for a new place)

period.description: What time it describes, e.g. 2026 or 2026-09

unit.description: The unit the figure is in, as list_metrics_and_sources gives it (e.g. EUR/month for rent in Lisbon). Checked against the metric's unit; leave it out only when you are sure

url.description: The page the figure was read on

value.description: A number, or 12 monthly numbers for a monthly metric. Money in the city's local currency.

name: record_observation
title: Keep a figure you read
